method: Paired before snapshot and current homepage served over local HTTP, identical seeded reels and local assets, fresh contexts and disabled cache, profile network and CPU throttling; capture at least 5 seconds after load and after the hero LCP is observed. Before/after ordering alternates per pair. Uncompressed local HTML/CSS; not production measurements.
